vsm1.1:143.1: Yaṃ pana vuttaṃ ‘‘ko cassa saṃkileso, kiṃ vodāna’’nti.
vsm1.1:143.2: Tatra vadāma – khaṇḍādibhāvo sīlassa saṃkileso, akhaṇḍādibhāvo vodānaṃ.
vsm1.1:143.3: So pana khaṇḍādibhāvo lābhayasādihetukena bhedena ca sattavidhamethunasaṃyogena ca saṅgahito.
vsm1.1:143.4: Tathā hi yassa sattasu āpattikkhandhesu ādimhi vā ante vā sikkhāpadaṃ bhinnaṃ hoti,
vsm1.1:143.5: tassa sīlaṃ pariyante chinnasāṭako viya khaṇḍaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm1.1:143.6: Yassa pana vemajjhe bhinnaṃ, tassa majjhe chiddasāṭako viya chiddaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm1.1:143.8: tassa piṭṭhiyā vā kucchiyā vā uṭṭhitena visabhāgavaṇṇena kāḷarattādīnaṃ aññatarasarīravaṇṇā gāvī viya sabalaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm1.1:143.10: tassa antarantarā visabhāgavaṇṇabinduvicitrā gāvī viya kammāsaṃ nāma hoti.
vsm1.1:143.11: Evaṃ tāva lābhādihetukena bhedena khaṇḍādibhāvo hoti.
vsm1.1:144.2: ‘‘Idha, brāhmaṇa, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā sammā brahmacārī paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati, apica kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ sambāhanaṃ sādiyati, so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati,
vsm1.1:144.3: idampi kho, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampi.
vsm1.1:144.4: Ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati saṃyutto methunena saṃyogena, na parimuccati jātiyā.
vsm1.1:144.5: Jarāya maraṇena…pe… na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:145.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… paṭijānamāno na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃ dvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ…pe… sādiyati. Apica kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkelāyati, so tadassādeti…pe… na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:146.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… na heva kho mātugāmena saddhiṃ dvayaṃ dvayasamāpattiṃ samāpajjati. Napi mātugāmassa ucchādanaṃ…pe… sādiyati. Napi mātugāmena saddhiṃ sañjagghati saṃkīḷati saṃkelāyati. Apica kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati, so tadassādeti…pe… na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:147.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… na heva kho mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa… napi mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa…pe… pekkhati. Apica kho mātugāmassa saddaṃ suṇāti tirokuṭṭā vā tiropākārā vā hasantiyā vā bhaṇantiyā vā gāyantiyā vā rodantiyā vā, so tadassādeti…pe… dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:148.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… na heva kho mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa… napi mātugāmena… napi mātugāmassa…pe… rodantiyā vā. Apica kho yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni, tāni anussarati, so tadassādeti…pe… dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:149.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… na heva kho mātugāmena…pe… napi mātugāmassa…pe… napi yānissa tāni pubbe mātugāmena saddhiṃ hasitalapitakīḷitāni, tāni anussarati. Apica kho passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ, so tadassādeti…pe… dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
vsm1.1:150.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idhekacco samaṇo vā…pe… na heva kho mātugāmena…pe… napi passati gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā…pe… paricārayamānaṃ. Apica kho aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti.
vsm1.1:150.2: So tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati.
vsm1.1:150.3: Idampi kho, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyassa khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampī’’ti (a. ni. 7.50).
vsm1.1:150.4: Evaṃ lābhādihetukena bhedena ca sattavidhamethunasaṃyogena ca khaṇḍādibhāvo saṅgahitoti veditabbo.
vsm1.1:151.1: Akhaṇḍādibhāvo pana sabbaso sikkhāpadānaṃ abhedena, bhinnānañca sappaṭikammānaṃ paṭikammakaraṇena,
vsm1.1:151.2: sattavidhamethunasaṃyogābhāvena ca, aparāya ca ‘‘kodho upanāho makkho paḷāso issā macchariyaṃ māyā sātheyyaṃ thambho sārambho māno atimāno mado pamādo’’tiādīnaṃ pāpadhammānaṃ anuppattiyā,
vsm1.1:152.1: Yāni hi sīlāni lābhādīnampi atthāya abhinnāni,
vsm1.1:152.3: methunasaṃyogehi vā kodhupanāhādīhi vā pāpadhammehi anupahatāni, tāni sabbaso akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsānīti vuccanti.
vsm1.1:152.4: Tāniyeva bhujissabhāvakaraṇato ca bhujissāni, viññūhi pasatthattā viññupasatthāni,
vsm1.1:152.5: taṇhādiṭṭhīhi aparāmaṭṭhattā aparāmaṭṭhāni, upacārasamādhiṃ vā appanāsamādhiṃ vā saṃvattayantīti samādhisaṃvattanikāni ca honti.
vsm1.1:153.1: Taṃ panetaṃ vodānaṃ dvīhākārehi sampajjati sīlavipattiyā ca ādīnavadassanena,
vsm1.1:153.3: Tattha ‘‘pañcime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.149; a. ni. 5.213) evamādisuttanayena sīlavipattiyā ādīnavo daṭṭhabbo.
vsm1.1:154.1: Apica dussīlo puggalo dussīlyahetu amanāpo hoti devamanussānaṃ, ananusāsanīyo sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
vsm1.1:154.2: dukkhito dussīlyagarahāsu, vippaṭisārī sīlavataṃ pasaṃsāsu, tāya ca pana dussīlyatāya sāṇasāṭako viya dubbaṇṇo hoti.
vsm1.1:154.3: Ye kho panassa diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjanti, tesaṃ dīgharattaṃ apāyadukkhāvahanato dukkhasamphasso.
vsm1.1:154.4: Yesaṃ deyyadhammaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, tesaṃ namahapphalakaraṇato appaggho.
vsm1.1:154.7: Bhikkhubhāvaṃ paṭijānantopi abhikkhuyeva gogaṇaṃ anubandhagadrabho viya.
vsm1.1:154.10: Sutādiguṇayuttopi sabrahmacārīnaṃ apūjāraho susānaggi viya brāhmaṇānaṃ.
vsm1.1:155.1: Dussīlānañhi pañcakāmaguṇaparibhogavandanamānanādisukhassādagadhitacittānaṃ tappaccayaṃ anussaraṇamattenāpi hadayasantāpaṃ janayitvā uṇhalohituggārappavattanasamatthaṃ atikaṭukaṃ dukkhaṃ dassento sabbākārena paccakkhakammavipāko bhagavā āha –
vsm1.1:155.2: ‘‘Passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūta’nti? Evaṃ, bhanteti.
vsm1.1:155.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āliṅgetvā upanisīdeyya vā upanipajjeyya vā, yaṃ khattiyakaññaṃ vā brāhmaṇakaññaṃ vā gahapatikaññaṃ vā mudutalunahatthapādaṃ āliṅgetvā upanisīdeyya vā upanipajjeyya vāti.
vsm1.1:155.4: Etadeva, bhante, varaṃ yaṃ khattiyakaññaṃ vā…pe… upanipajjeyya vā.
vsm1.1:155.5: Dukkhaṃ hetaṃ, bhante, yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ…pe… upanipajjeyya vāti.
vsm1.1:156.1: Ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, yathā etadeva tassa varaṃ dussīlassa pāpadhammassa asucisaṅkassarasamācārassa paṭicchannakammantassa assamaṇassa samaṇapaṭiññassa abrahmacārissa brahmacāripaṭiññassa antopūtikassa avassutassa kasambujātassa yaṃ amuṃ mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ…pe… upanipajjeyya vā.
vsm1.1:156.2: Taṃ kissa hetu? Tatonidānaṃ hi so, bhikkhave, maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ, na tveva tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā’’ti (a. ni. 7.72).
vsm1.1:157.1: Evaṃ aggikkhandhupamāya itthipaṭibaddhapañcakāmaguṇaparibhogapaccayaṃ dukkhaṃ dassetvā eteneva upāyena –
vsm1.1:157.2: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso daḷhāya vāḷarajjuyā ubho jaṅghā veṭhetvā ghaṃseyya, sā chaviṃ chindeyya, chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindeyya, cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindeyya,
vsm1.1:157.3: maṃsaṃ chetvā nhāruṃ chindeyya, nhāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindeyya, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhimiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭheyya,
vsm1.1:157.4: yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā abhivādanaṃ sādiyeyyā’’ti ca.
vsm1.1:157.5: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tiṇhāya sattiyā teladhotāya paccorasmiṃ pahareyya,
vsm1.1:157.6: yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā añjalikammaṃ sādiyeyyā’’ti ca.
vsm1.1:157.7: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayopaṭṭena ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena kāyaṃ sampaliveṭheyya,
vsm1.1:157.8: yaṃ vā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ vā brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ vā gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.
vsm1.1:157.9: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso tattena ayosaṅkunā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena mukhaṃ vivaritvā tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ mukhe pakkhipeyya,
vsm1.1:157.10: taṃ tassa oṭṭhampi ḍaheyya, mukhampi, jivhampi, kaṇṭhampi, udarampi ḍaheyya, antampi antaguṇampi ādāya adhobhāgaṃ nikkhameyya,
vsm1.1:157.11: yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.
vsm1.1:157.12: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā tattaṃ ayomañcaṃ vā ayopīṭhaṃ vā ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ abhinisīdāpeyya vā abhinipajjāpeyya vā,
vsm1.1:157.13: yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti ca.
vsm1.1:157.14: ‘‘Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho varaṃ yaṃ balavā puriso uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya ayokumbhiyā pakkhipeyya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya,
vsm1.1:157.15: so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gaccheyya, sakimpi adho gaccheyya, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gaccheyya, yaṃ vā khattiya… brāhmaṇa… gahapatimahāsālānaṃ vā saddhādeyyaṃ vihāraṃ paribhuñjeyyā’’ti cāti (a. ni. 7.72).
vsm1.1:158.3:
Saddhānamañjalikammasādiyane kiṃ sukhaṃ asīlassa;
Sattippahāradukkhādhimattadukkhassa yaṃhetu.
vsm1.1:158.4:
Cīvaraparibhogasukhaṃ, kiṃ nāma asaṃyatassa;
Yena ciraṃ anubhavitabbo, niraye jalitaayopaṭṭasamphasso.
vsm1.1:158.5:
Madhuropi piṇḍapāto, halāhalavisūpamo asīlassa;
Ādittā gilitabbā, ayoguḷā yena cirarattaṃ.
vsm1.1:158.6:
Sukhasammatopi dukkho, asīlino mañcapīṭhaparibhogo;
Yaṃ bādhissanti ciraṃ, jalitaayomañcapīṭhāni.
vsm1.1:158.7:
Dussīlassa vihāre, saddhādeyyamhi kā nivāsa rati;
Jalitesu nivasitabbaṃ, yena ayokumbhimajjhesu.
vsm1.1:158.8:
Saṅkasarasamācāro, kasambujāto avassuto pāpo;
Antopūtīti ca yaṃ, nindanto āha lokagaru.
vsm1.1:158.9:
Dhī jīvitaṃ asaññatassa, tassa samaṇajanavesadhārissa;
Assamaṇassa upahataṃ, khatamattānaṃ vahantassa.
vsm1.1:158.10:
Gūthaṃ viya kuṇapaṃ viya, maṇḍanakāmā vivajjayantīdha;
Yaṃ nāma sīlavanto, santo kiṃ jīvitaṃ tassa.
vsm1.1:158.11:
Sabbabhayehi amutto, mutto sabbehi adhigamasukhehi;
Supihitasaggadvāro, apāyamaggaṃ samārūḷho.
vsm1.1:158.12:
Karuṇāya vatthubhūto, kāruṇikajanassa nāma ko añño;
Dussīlasamo dussī, latāya iti bahuvidhā dosāti.
vsm1.1:158.13: Evamādinā paccavekkhaṇena sīlavipattiyaṃ ādīnavadassanaṃ vuttappakāraviparītato sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsadassanañca veditabbaṃ. Apica –
vsm1.1:159.1:
Tassa pāsādikaṃ hoti, pattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ;
Pabbajjā saphalā tassa, yassa sīlaṃ sunimmalaṃ.
vsm1.1:159.2:
Attānuvādādibhayaṃ, suddhasīlassa bhikkhuno;
Andhakāraṃ viya raviṃ, hadayaṃ nāvagāhati.
vsm1.1:159.3:
Sīlasampattiyā bhikkhu, sobhamāno tapovane;
Pabhāsampattiyā cando, gagane viya sobhati.
vsm1.1:159.4:
Kāyagandhopi pāmojjaṃ, sīlavantassa bhikkhuno;
Karoti api devānaṃ, sīlagandhe kathāva kā.
vsm1.1:159.5:
Sabbesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sampattiṃ abhibhuyyati;
Avighātī disā sabbā, sīlagandho pavāyati.
vsm1.1:159.6:
Appakāpi katā kārā, sīlavante mahapphalā;
Hontīti sīlavā hoti, pūjāsakkārabhājanaṃ.
vsm1.1:159.7:
Sīlavantaṃ na bādhanti, āsavā diṭṭhadhammikā;
Samparāyikadukkhānaṃ, mūlaṃ khanati sīlavā.
vsm1.1:159.8:
Yā manussesu sampatti, yā ca devesu sampadā;
Na sā sampannasīlassa, icchato hoti dullabhā.
vsm1.1:159.9:
Accantasantā pana yā, ayaṃ nibbānasampadā;
Mano sampannasīlassa, tameva anudhāvati.
vsm1.1:159.10:
Sabbasampattimūlamhi, sīlamhi iti paṇḍito;
Anekākāravokāraṃ, ānisaṃsaṃ vibhāvayeti.
vsm1.1:160.1: Evañhi vibhāvayato sīlavipattito ubbijjitvā sīlasampattininnaṃ mānasaṃ hoti.
vsm1.1:160.2: Tasmā yathāvuttaṃ imaṃ sīlavipattiyā ādīnavaṃ imañca sīlasampattiyā ānisaṃsaṃ disvā sabbādarena sīlaṃ vodāpetabbanti.
vsm1.1:161.1: Ettāvatā ca ‘‘sīle patiṭṭhāya naro sapañño’’ti imissā gāthāya sīlasamādhipaññāmukhena desite visuddhimagge sīlaṃ tāva paridīpitaṃ hoti.
vsm1.1:161.2: Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge Sīlaniddeso nāma paṭhamo paricchedo.
